description:
Hello there and welcome to my channel, Critique Quest!

I’m an avid reader, writer, player of video games and watcher (like Rupert Giles) of most things! My passion, however, and the focus of this channel are video games and their soundtracks, both of which I love to talk about here. Feel free to take a look around, take in the sights and by all means graffiti... in the... comment section (that didn't quite work, did it?)
